Quantified Citizen · Survey recreation

Chronic Headache & Psychedelics — the survey as participants saw it

Deployed revision 17 · published 2024-11-22 · the exact version all 101 respondents completed · reconstructed from the published-study database

This is an interactive recreation of the live questionnaire, rebuilt from its stored definition so you can see how each question was actually presented and how the answer options were worded. A couple of things worth looking at:

  • On the psychedelic-use page, the two “most frequent dose” questions: the one whose stored variable is 4_5_lsd asks about Psilocybin, in grams, and the one stored as 4_5_psil asks about LSD, in micrograms — the variable names are crossed, which is the source of the swapped-column issue.
  • The 6_7 “headache days per month” question is a free-numeric field — you’ll see it accepts any number, with no minimum or maximum, which is why values above 31 appear in the data.
  • The intro page screens participants: answering “No” to having chronic headaches, or to having used psychedelics, routes them to the submit page rather than the full questionnaire — the survey’s original skip logic is preserved here.

Note: faithful recreation of the question content and branching logic from the published survey definition; production styling is approximated. This is a preview only — nothing is recorded or submitted.

This is the end of the questionnaire. This is a read-only recreation, so no response was recorded.
